caption: An agent is just one repetitive job, done for you, in your voice. Replying to enquiries, chasing quotes, nudging past customers. You stay in charge and it hands anything tricky back to you. Which job would you hand off first? Comment AGENT below.

slides.headline: What's an agent? One job, done for you.
It's not a robot taking over.
slides.body: It's a helper that does one repetitive task so you don't have to.

slides.headline: Pick the job that eats your week.
slides.body: Replying to enquiries. Chasing quotes. Booking times. Asking for reviews.

slides.headline: It works in your voice.
slides.body: Messages sound like you, not like a stiff template.

slides.headline: It knows when to stop.
slides.body: Anything tricky or unsure gets handed straight back to you.

slides.headline: You stay in charge.
slides.body: Pause it, change it or turn it off whenever you like.
